DIRECTION A — PADDOCK

An editorial almanac rather than a timing screen: warm paper, ink-black type, hairline rules, tabular figures. Deliberately the opposite of the current near-black + red app, because dense tables read far better on light ground.

The team colour is the only accent on each page and is a tweak — switch it to see a Ferrari or McLaren page.

Two alternate directions are on the Directions page.

EVERY NUMBER IS REAL

Pulled from the live Supabase project: Antonelli's 292 points and 8 wins, his P19→P1 at Monza, the Spain retirement, Mercedes' 503 to Ferrari's 358, and Madrid's finishing order. Norris took pole there by 0.011s.

Two things are honestly marked as not-yet-available: the driver career table (needs the 2000–2026 backfill) and past winners at Madrid (inaugural running).
